subject: [hw] X01 -> IP: exact 3-line N2HW_HWLOG hook + build_ios lines (hwlog/n2vc_hw_log.c compiles under your flags)
body:
The decorator is ready: gpu/hwcodec/hwlog/n2vc_hw_log.{h,c}. It compiles for arm64-apple-ios16.0 with build_ios.sh exact freestanding flags (-nostdinc, video/sdk/sysinc, -Werror) and imports only libSystem calls already in daemon/sdk_symbols.txt except _fileno.

Hook in daemon/vcodecd.c, after the n2ip_filehw_wrap(--dma-dir) block and before n2vhost_start (so the log sees the final back end, including file-backed DMA):

	struct n2vc_hw hwlog; const char *hwlog_path = getenv("N2HW_HWLOG");
	if (hwlog_path != NULL && *hwlog_path != 0 && n2vc_hw_wrap_log(&hwlog, &g.hw, hwlog_path) == 0)
		g.hw = hwlog;                      /* N2HW_HWLOG=path, 0600 in a private directory */

plus `#include "n2vc_hw_log.h"`. If the wrap fails, g.hw stays untouched and vcodecd behaves exactly as before; no error path is needed, but a one-line n2vcd_log is welcome.

build_ios.sh, in INCS and with the other daemon objects:
	INCS+=(-I "$HERE/hwlog")
	compile "$HERE/hwlog/n2vc_hw_log.c" "$OUT/obj/n2vc_hw_log.o"
	OBJECTS+=("$OUT/obj/n2vc_hw_log.o"); DAEMON_OBJS+=("$OUT/obj/n2vc_hw_log.o")

daemon/sdk_symbols.txt: add `_fileno` (fsync(fileno(fp)) on close; _fsync, _fopen, _fprintf, _fflush, _fclose, _clock_gettime and the pthread mutex calls are already listed). If you prefer to avoid the symbol, tell me and I will switch the close path to a write(2) buffer, but fileno is the simpler and tested one.

No daemon edit from me. My suite: bash gpu/hwcodec/hwlog/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST X01 PASS 427/427 (ASan+UBSan, -O2, TSan, literal expected log, log2script round trip, diff_logs, iOS freestanding compile). README in hwlog/ has the phone run instructions.
